meta.source: DAFMAN 36-2806, Military Awards: Criteria and Procedures, Attachment 5
meta.notes: Transcribed from Attachment 5 of AFMAN 36-2806 dated 10 June 2019 (paragraphs A5.1 and A5.2.1 through A5.2.11), the last copy of the manual readable outside a .mil network; the Purple Heart (A5.2.6) has no citation and is omitted. The current DAFMAN 36-2806 keeps the same paragraph numbers, but the wording has not been read against it, so this file stays a stub. The 2019 manual names the Air Force Commendation and Achievement Medals; the labels and certificate titles here use the Air and Space names myDecs prints. The Air National Guard closing is A5.1.5, applied to each decoration at that decoration's level of credit. Certificate headers: the Achievement and Commendation Medals print under the Department of the Air Force header and the Meritorious Service Medal under the Presidential header with its Executive Order line, all three read off certificates myDecs printed; the other decorations are given the Presidential header on the strength of being Presidential awards, with no authority line, because none has been read off a certificate. The Space Force closing ('United States Space Force') is an assumption, not a transcription. Short titles follow A5.1.6; Chaplain titles are not handled.

rules.text: The inclusive period stays on one line.
"long and" in a retirement closing is for 30 or more years of service. Air National Guard members not on extended active duty take the Guard closing.

No abbreviations other than Jr., Sr., II, III after the name; spell out the grade in the opening sentence, then use the short title. Code names such as RED FLAG are fine. Never split the member's name across two lines.
Numeric unit designators read 3rd Aerospace Wing, 4th Mission Support Group.
Numbers through nine are spelled out unless space is limited.
Only abbreviations and acronyms on the approved DAF list.
